title: nazm.snapshot/1
description: One root compilation's durable definitions, from `nazm snapshot --json` and the `nazm-mcp` tool `nazm.semantic_snapshot`: every function, record and enum declared from a file of the compilation with a durable definition key, each with one BLAKE3 digest per semantic section the compiler records. `status` is `available` with every section, or `unavailable` with a `reason` and no other section. A digest is evidence that the canonical data it was taken over is equal, never that behaviour is. Paths are relative to the source root; nothing session-local or host-specific is included, so the same sources give the same bytes from any checkout.

reason.description: Why there is no snapshot: some file needed syntax recovery or a module could not be loaded, or the root module has no durable key. Present only when `status` is `unavailable`.

definitions.description: Ordered by identity; each identity once.

untracked.description: Definitions of the compilation with no durable identity — declared in a module outside the source root — left out rather than matched by a path or a name.

unsupported.description: What a snapshot does not record, and so can never report unchanged.

module.description: The root module's durable key: its path relative to the source root.

compiler.description: The compiler whose canonical data the digests were taken over; a delta refuses a baseline from another.

declaration.description: Where it is declared, for navigation. Not compared: moving a definition is no change.

shape.description: Kind, visibility, and the signature, or the fields, or the variants and payloads.

dependencies.description: The source-linked entities it uses, by identity and count.

related_types.description: The records and enums it writes by name, by identity and count.

references.description: Its uses, by the identity of the definition each is in, and count.

callers.description: A function's direct checked callers, by identity and count; null for a record or an enum.

callees.description: A function's direct checked callees, by identity and count; null for a record or an enum.

diagnostics.description: Code, severity, fix count and relative range of each diagnostic whose primary span is inside it; never a message.
